name: vidscotch
description: Allows for better control of video when mouse is over the video with arrow keys. Alt/Ctrl/Shift+L/R advances by 1/30, 1 and 20 secs respectively. Alt/Ctrl/Shift+U/D changes vol by 1%, 5% and 20%. All can be combined. Alt + j/l will increase/decreast playback speed. Adds skip button.
